rv.q: Kelly's poignant and hilariously subversive show exposes the impossible standards of the Catholic Church.
McCaughan’s mission is to undo some of the shame religion has instilled, both for herself and her audience, and her chosen method is a bizarre, clownish exorcism.

cn.t: McCaughan's hilariously subversive show earns praise for turning Catholic upbringing into outrageous comedy, with critics applauding her shameless clowning and poignant exposure of the Church's impossible standards.
